# `<syslog.h>`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

POSIX system log, backed by logsvc through LogWrite().

Do not include this together with <util/log.h>: both define LOG_DEBUG.

```c
#include <syslog.h>
```

## Constants

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="log_emerg"></a>`LOG_EMERG` | `0` | System is unusable. |
| <a id="log_alert"></a>`LOG_ALERT` | `1` | Act at once. |
| <a id="log_crit"></a>`LOG_CRIT` | `2` | Critical condition. |
| <a id="log_err"></a>`LOG_ERR` | `3` | Error. |
| <a id="log_warning"></a>`LOG_WARNING` | `4` | Warning. |
| <a id="log_notice"></a>`LOG_NOTICE` | `5` | Normal but significant. |
| <a id="log_info"></a>`LOG_INFO` | `6` | Informational. |
| <a id="log_debug"></a>`LOG_DEBUG` | `7` | Debug detail. |
| <a id="log_mask"></a>`LOG_MASK(pri)` |  | Mask holding only priority `pri`. |
| <a id="log_upto"></a>`LOG_UPTO(pri)` |  | Mask holding `pri` and every more important priority. |
| <a id="log_primask"></a>`LOG_PRIMASK` | `0x07` | Mask of the priority bits in a syslog() argument. |
| <a id="log_pid"></a>`LOG_PID` | `0x01` | openlog() option: add the process id to each message. |
| <a id="log_cons"></a>`LOG_CONS` | `0x02` | openlog() option: accepted and ignored. |
| <a id="log_ndelay"></a>`LOG_NDELAY` | `0x08` | openlog() option: accepted and ignored. |
| <a id="log_perror"></a>`LOG_PERROR` | `0x20` | openlog() option: also write each message to stderr. |
| <a id="log_user"></a>`LOG_USER` | `(1 << 3)` | Facility: accepted and ignored. |
| <a id="log_daemon"></a>`LOG_DAEMON` | `(3 << 3)` | Facility: accepted and ignored. |

## Functions

### `openlog` { #openlog }

```c
void openlog(const char *ident, int option, int facility);
```

Sets the tag and options for later syslog() calls.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ident` | in | Tag put on each message; copied, and cut to 31 characters. NULL for none. |
| `option` | in | LOG_PID, LOG_PERROR; the rest are ignored. |
| `facility` | in | Ignored. |

### `closelog` { #closelog }

```c
void closelog(void);
```

Forgets the tag and options set by openlog().

### `setlogmask` { #setlogmask }

```c
int setlogmask(int mask);
```

Sets which priorities syslog() lets through.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `mask` | in | Priorities to keep, built with LOG_MASK() or LOG_UPTO(); 0 leaves it unchanged. |

**Returns:** The previous mask.

### `syslog` { #syslog }

```c
void syslog(int priority, const char *format,...);
```

Logs a message.

Priorities map to logsvc levels: EMERG, ALERT and CRIT to FATAL; ERR to ERROR; WARNING to WARN; NOTICE and INFO to INFO; DEBUG to DEBUG.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `priority` | in | LOG_EMERG to LOG_DEBUG, optionally with a facility, which is ignored. |
| `format` | in | printf-style format. |

### `vsyslog` { #vsyslog }

```c
void vsyslog(int priority, const char *format, va_list ap);
```

syslog() with a va_list.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `priority` | in | As for syslog(). |
| `format` | in | printf-style format. |
| `ap` | in | The arguments. |
